subject: Request: retirement of project prompts/outputs and verification evidence
messages:
From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@greenwavehealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com
Cc: ops+inbound@greenwavehealth.com, GreenWave Health Legal <legal@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: remove prompts/outputs/logs for project ‘GWH-clinical-assist’

Hi Neha,

We need Redwood to retire all prompt inputs, generation outputs, and any associated request logs tied to our internal project "GWH-clinical-assist" — captured under project id GWH-4592 — across your hosted environment and any cached KV/store entries. This is a data-residency/retention request from our privacy team.

Can you confirm the full workflow you will run, an estimated SLA for completion, and provide verification evidence once the work is done (hashes, scrub logs, and a redaction summary)? Our legal team also needs a signed acknowledgement for our records.

Thanks,
Alex Jensen
Director, Data & Privacy
GreenWave Health

--
Attachment: gwh_log_excerpt_20260830.csv (CSV, 18 KB)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remove prompts/outputs/logs for project ‘GWH-clinical-assist’

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear request and excerpt. High level: we will run a controlled retirement job that targets (a) prompt-level request logs, (b) derived outputs-and-artifacts stored in prompt-output logs, and (c) any KV cache entries labelled for project GWH-4592.

Estimated timeline: 3 business days for queued scheduling + run + verification; if any manual review is required we’ll escalate and update the timeline.

What we'll provide after completion:
- A signed Redaction & Retirement Confirmation PDF (summarizes counts, namespaces, and time windows)
- A scrub log with SHA256 digests for removed files (where applicable)
- A short playbook excerpt describing the steps we ran (for your SOC/audit team)

Next steps from your side: please sign the Data Erasure Acknowledgement (DocuSign link below) so we can schedule the reserved run on our Dedicated workflow. Also confirm whether this needs to include any logs older than 24 months (we currently retain some parity logs for 90 days).

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/envelope-0a9f4b
HubSpot: GWH-4592

Regards,
Neha Kapoor

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: remove prompts/outputs/logs for project ‘GWH-clinical-assist’

Marissa et al — proposed runbook below. This is targeted for our Dedicated purge workflow with rollback safeguards and audit hooks:

1) Snapshot current namespaces (read-only export) — provide CSV manifest (for audit).
2) Run KV cache invalidation for project tag GWH-4592 across edge caches.
3) Delete prompt-request logs and payloads from prompt-store (isolate by project id).
4) Delete generated outputs and model artifacts labelled with GWH-4592.
5) Run integrity check: attempt to re-query a small sample and verify 404/no-content.
6) Produce scrub logs with file-level SHA256 digest and a consolidated redaction_evidence_20260901.pdf.

Estimated run time: 45–90 minutes. I will require SRE to approve window and set temporary throttles. Recovery plan: we keep the pre-deletion snapshots in a secure WORM bucket for 30 days (audit-only access) in case legal requires additional proof; we do not use snapshots for rehydration into customer-facing state without explicit approval.

I'll start the job Wednesday 2026-09-01 02:00 UTC (17:00 PDT Tue) if the DocuSign is signed and SRE confirms.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Reliability Engineer, Inference Runtime
